Definition: Integration of health records, patient registration, immunization data, and health insurance into data exchange
Comments: A significant interoperability workshop was held Nov 2025 (organized by Terre des Hommes, Ministry of Health, funded by Enabel/Wehubit) to transfer technical skills on health information system interoperability. A cartography of digital health tools was completed. SNIS (National Health Information System) and SMSI are being equipped for interoperability. The system is under active development toward interoperability. National Health Information System modernization is a stated priority.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed. Fetched the original guineenews.org article (Nov 2025 workshop on SNIS/SMSI interoperability) and corroborated with Guinea's National Digital Health Strategy 2021-2025 (which sets 'normes et interoperabilite' as a strategic pillar, P311/P312) and PASA2 programme records showing DHIS2 deployed across all health districts since 2022 but data-quality/server security still weak and cross-system exchange not yet operational. Evidence supports 'Under development' (3): active capacity-building and standards work is underway, but no functioning data-exchange integration with other government systems is documented, so the code is confirmed rather than upgraded to 'Partially integrated'.

Definition: Integration of passport issuance and immigration control data into the exchange platform
Comments: Passport issuance was fully digitized in 2025 as part of Guinea's 39 public service applications deployment through the unified digital portal. However, integration with a broader data exchange layer (sharing data with other systems) is not documented. The digitization represents an under-development integration rather than full exchange capability.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed. Fetched the wearetech.africa 2025 sector review (passport issuance digitised via unified portal, decentralised biometric enrolment since June 2025) and corroborated with ANDE/World Bank WARDIP 'e-Services et interoperabilite' workshop (April 2026), which names passport issuance as one of the priority services still being brought into the government-wide interoperability/data-exchange programme, i.e. not yet integrated. Border-control tools such as PISCES X (Nov 2024) synchronise biometric data with international systems (INTERPOL, IOM MIDAS, US CBP) but there is no evidence of integration with a domestic government data-exchange platform. This supports 'Under development' (3); code confirmed, not upgraded.
